credential_type.quote: "License" means, unless the context requires otherwise, a license issued by the Board to: (i) provide plumbing services

is_mandatory.quote: an individual who is licensed by the Board to provide plumbing services

title_protection.quote: "Master plumber" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to provide plumbing services and natural gas services.

scope_protection.quote: an individual who is licensed by the Board to provide plumbing services while under the direction and control of a master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license

definition_quote.value: "Provide plumbing services" means to install, maintain, extend, alter, or remove piping, a plumbing fixture, a plumbing appliance, a plumbing appurtenance, or other plumbing apparatus: (i) within or adjacent to a building, structure, or property; and (ii) in connection with: 1. a public or private disposal system, sanitary drainage facility, or storm drainage facility; 2. a venting system; or 3. a public or private water supply system.
definition_quote.quote: "Provide plumbing services" means to install, maintain, extend, alter, or remove piping, a plumbing fixture, a plumbing appliance, a plumbing appurtenance, or other plumbing apparatus: (i) within or adjacent to a building, structure, or property; and (ii) in connection with: 1. a public or private disposal system, sanitary drainage facility, or storm drainage facility; 2. a venting system; or 3. a public or private water supply system.

methods_authorized.quote: "Provide plumbing services" means to install, maintain, extend, alter, or remove piping, a plumbing fixture, a plumbing appliance, a plumbing appurtenance, or other plumbing apparatus

license_tiers.quote: "License" includes, unless the context requires otherwise, each of the following licenses: (i) a master plumber license; (ii) a journey plumber license; (iii) an apprentice plumber license; (iv) a limited license; (v) a propane gas fitter certificate; (vi) a master natural gas fitters license; (vii) a journeyman natural gas fitters license; and (viii) an apprentice natural gas fitters license.

apprentice_supervision_requirement.value: An apprentice plumber must work under the direction and control of a master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license.
apprentice_supervision_requirement.quote: under the direction and control of the master plumber or holder of the limited master plumber license

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: Each unit shall issue an expedited license to a service member, veteran, or military spouse who meets the requirements of this section.
expedited_licensure_pathway_available.citation: UMBRELLA / Title 2.5 - Service Members, Veterans, and Military Spouses

gas_supply_work_included_in_scope.quote: "Provide plumbing services" includes installing, repairing, servicing, and replacing gas piping, gas utilization equipment, and associated accessories.

fire_sprinkler_work_authorized.quote: "providing plumbing services" does not include using piping, equipment, or material only for: ... (iii) the installation, alteration, repair, or removal of an automatic sprinkler system, related apparatus, or standpipe that is used only for fire protection

scope__license_tiers.quote: "Apprentice plumber" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to assist a master plumber or a holder of a limited master plumber license in providing plumbing services
"Apprentice natural gas fitter" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to assist a master natural gas fitter in providing natural gas services

"Journey plumber" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to provide plumbing services while under the direction and control of a master plumber or holder of a limited master plumber license.

"Journeyman natural gas fitter" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to provide natural gas services while under the direction and control of a master natural gas fitter.
"Master plumber" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to provide plumbing services and natural gas services.
"Master natural gas fitter" means, unless the context requires otherwise, an individual who is licensed by the Board to provide natural gas services.
